versions.changelog:
- Added sample project file: "desert-bath-co-henderson-nv.md" for reference implementations.
- Introduced two new prompt templates: "03-reputation-referral.md" (reputation & referral systems) and "04-digital-ads-local-seo.md" (digital ads & local SEO).
- Added "package.json" to define dependencies and skill structure.  
- No changes to compliance gates or core functionality; this is a minor update focused on adding sample content and prompt templates.

Bathroom Remodeling Marketing Kit v1.0.0

- Launches a marketing kit specifically designed for bathroom remodeling contractors.
- Generates marketing copy including seasonal campaigns, service pages with JSON-LD, referral systems, and digital ads.
- Enforces seven compliance gates to eliminate liability-generating claims commonly found in generic marketing content.
- Addresses and corrects typical compliance errors related to licensing, EPA regulations, permitting, accessibility, mold remediation, structural engineering, and warranty/FTC rules.
- Guarantees that all outputs conform to federal, state, and local regulatory standards.
